notes: §1985:XIV.2.2.4 GR11: data-name-8 gives 'the number of character positions filled as a result of the execution of the RECEIVE statement'. Transfer writes the length of the text Next took (bounded by identifier-1's size) through SetReceived, and a RECEIVE that finds no data writes 0 (Receive). Probes gr1/gr12/rc1 at --std 85: 5 for 'HELLO' into X(20), 9 then 1 for a 10-character message into X(9), 3/3 for segments, 3 into ref-mod (8:3), 7 into an ODO group, 0 on NO DATA; an unknown queue leaves it as written with status 20 ('No action taken', Table 1). The witness checks 0005.

next.reason: 1985: "The MCS indicates via the content of the data item referenced by data-name-8 the number of character positions filled"; 2023: "No communication description entry in 2023. The RECEIVE/SEND candidates use identifier-1 and set no text-length item.". 2023 drops the CD entry and its text-length field. No candidate states that the MCS reports the count of character positions filled by RECEIVE.
